## Description

Test common navigation flows in Stack in Tabs configuration

## Steps

### Baseline

1. Launch the app and navigate to the **Stack in Tabs - basic navigation scenarios** screen.

   - [ ] A tab navigation bar is visible with three destinations: _First_, _Second_, _Stack_.
   - [ ] _First_ is selected.

---

### Tab navigation

1. Navigate to the _Second_ tab.

   - [ ] Second tab is selected correctly.

2. Navigate to the _Stack_ tab.

   - [ ] _First_ route there is displayed correctly.

3. Toggle between _First_ and _Stack_ tabs.

   - [ ] Tabs do change "normally", there is no crash.

---

### Nested container state preservation

1. Navigate to the _Stack_ tab.

2. Push _Second_ screen.

3. Push _Third_ screen.

   - [ ] Both _Second_ and _Third_ are pushed onto the stack.

4. Toggle between _First_ and _Stack_ tabs.

   - [ ] _Stack_ tab displays nested stack with _Third_ route on top.
